releaseNotes: A redesigned dashboard groups the detailed views into Today, Assignments, School updates, Learning and Progress, with an action-focused family overview.

Assignments adds To do, Completed and All work views with priority or school-week grouping. School updates combines teacher posts and mail with private Reviewed and Undo controls saved in this browser.

Per-student view preferences and reading position are preserved during refreshes. School sync progress is non-blocking, and Resources adds school-week filter buttons and visible Open actions on narrow screens.
Existing credentials, schedules, saved resources, student history and local assignment completion status are preserved. School access remains read-only.
